snapshot.title: Boil Water Advisory Draft — Zone 3

fields.subject: FW: Boil Water Advisory Draft (Pre-Printed Template)
fields.note: This is the official draft of the Boil Water Advisory for Zone 3, generated from the pre-printed template in MDWS-PCP-2026, Section 10.5. The Water Quality Manager approved the facts via radio at 11:28. The template was released through the internal draft queue and is now being forwarded for final approval and public release. Please act immediately — the media is already reporting on the boil water risk.
fields.signature:
Jamie Reis
Public Information Officer Assistant

original.subject: Boil Water Advisory Draft (Pre-Printed Template)
original.body:
Draft: Boil Water Advisory — Zone 3

Due to a cyber incident affecting control systems, water quality testing is delayed. Sampling is underway. A boil water advisory is in effect for Zone 3. Please boil water for 1 minute before drinking. Continue to avoid contact with tap water until further notice.

[Approved by: Marcus Oyelaran, Water Quality Manager — 11:28]

Template: MDWS-PCP-2026, Section 10.5 (Boil Water Advisory).

snapshot.instructorNote: This is the official trigger for public release of the boil water advisory. The PIO must confirm and initiate release across all channels immediately. Watch for delays in media activation or confusion over the advisory's status.
